json.name: Dev Jagdish Chavda

education.degree: B.Tech. in Information Technology, Honours in Data Science

experience.description:
Designed and shipped a multi-agent LLM assistant for internal company use covering question-answering over sales and hierarchy data, high-reasoning strategy planning with read-only database tools, and action-taking via internal services - exposed behind authenticated FastAPI REST endpoints with strict context-level security.
Built a history-based cart recommendation feature for retailer orders that surfaces relevant products from each retailer's past purchase patterns.
Implemented an in-app chat system for the company's field sales team using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) with a fan-out delivery model, avoiding the operational overhead of running a WebSocket server.

projects.name: DevX AI - Conversational AI Assistant
projects.description: Designed and deployed an end-to-end, general-purpose conversational assistant supporting multi-turn interactions over a FastAPI backend. Implemented contextual memory so the assistant carries information across turns and produces coherent, intent-aware responses. Added tool orchestration so the assistant can call external tools when needed to answer questions outside the LLM's own knowledge.

projects.name: AI-Based Image Searcher
projects.description: Built a fully-offline desktop application that retrieves images from personal folders using natural-language queries, running entirely on-device via Ollama. Used a vision-language model to generate multiple text descriptions per image (short caption, paragraph description, detailed summary) and indexed those description chunks along with image metadata in a FAISS vector store. At query time, retrieved the most relevant description chunks from FAISS and surfaced the corresponding images as recommendations to the user.

projects.name: Agentic Honey Pot System
projects.description: Built a chat endpoint where an LLM agent engages suspected scammers in conversation, keeping the dialogue alive while extracting intent and identity signals from each exchange. Scored 84 / 100 and finished Top 2% (Rank 13) at the HCL GUVI Hackathon, AI India Impact Summit 2026, Delhi.
